Re: Offer of Employment — Senior Product Designer (Req. DES-0219)

Dear ⟦name|Rose⟧,

On behalf of Tidewater Analytics, Inc. ("Tidewater" or the "Company"), I am delighted to offer you the position of Senior Product Designer on our Platform team. You will report to ⟦name|Will Baker⟧, Director of Design, and you will work from our Arlington office on a hybrid schedule (Tuesday through Thursday on site). Everyone on the panel mentioned your portfolio review; ⟦name|Will⟧ said it was the first time a candidate had quoted Dieter Rams back at him and been right.

The terms of our offer are as follows:

1. Start Date. Your first day will be Monday, November 2, 2026, or another date we agree in writing.

2. Base Salary. $148,500.00 per year, paid semi-monthly in accordance with the Company's normal payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. This is an exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

3. Sign-On Bonus. A one-time bonus of $10,000.00, payable on the first regular payroll after your start date. If you resign or are terminated for Cause within 12 months of your start date, you agree to repay a pro-rated portion.

4. Equity. Subject to approval by the Company's Board of Directors, you will be granted an option to purchase 18,000 shares of Common Stock under the 2021 Equity Incentive Plan, at an exercise price equal to fair market value on the date of grant (most recently $4.12 per share under the 409A valuation dated June 30, 2026). The option vests over four years: 25% on the first anniversary of your start date and the rest in 36 equal monthly installments.

5. Benefits. You will be eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage from your start date, a 401(k) plan with a Company match of 100% of the first 4% of eligible pay, 20 days of paid time off, 11 Company holidays, and a $1,500 annual learning stipend.

6. At-Will Employment. Your employment with Tidewater is "at will," meaning that either you or the Company may end it at any time, with or without cause or notice. This can only be changed in a writing signed by you and the Company's CEO.

7. Contingencies. This offer is contingent on (a) satisfactory completion of a background check by ClearPath Screening Solutions, with your written authorization; (b) your signing the Company's Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement; and (c) proof of identity and authorization to work in the United States. For Form I-9, please bring original documents on your first day, for example a U.S. passport, or a driver's license together with your Social Security card. Please do not email copies of these documents.

This offer will remain open until 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Benefits questions can go to people@tidewateranalytics.com; for anything else, call me on my cell at ⟦phone number|703 914 2286⟧, I'll pick up through Friday.

We are genuinely excited about what you will build here.

Sincerely,

Straits Maritime has moved bulk and project cargo around Asia since 1987. Today we are 2,300 people in 11 countries, and our Shared Services Centre in Singapore runs finance and people operations for all of them.

• Run end-to-end monthly payroll for ~1,150 employees in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia

• Excel you are proud of (XLOOKUP, Power Query); ADP Celergo, Workday or SAP SuccessFactors EC Payroll
• Nice to have: Bahasa Indonesia or Bahasa Melayu; SHRI or CPP certification
